blocks.html:
This method retrieves a product type by its ID. It sends a request to the 
[Get Product Type](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-types\_getproducttypesid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the product type.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the product type was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the product type was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the product type was deleted.

children.name: external_id
children.description: An external ID for the product type.
